message:
## Brief

**Goal:** Copy the booking wizard from `reference/booking-flow.html` into the clinic prototype (`proto-clinic/index.html`, Northside Physio) as the New appointment flow, with the same steps and the same look.

- **Prototype:** `proto-clinic/index.html`, the only one in the folder. It will be served locally as plain HTML.
- **Reference:** `reference/booking-flow.html`, a local file. It is read only and I will not edit it.
- **Mode:** exact, because you said "exactly ... same look". I will match sizes, spacing, colours and fonts, and measure both pages to prove it.
- **Screen it changes:** the "New appointment" button on Today is dead today. It will open the new flow.
- **Step skills found:** none. There is no `product-design` or `design-review` skill, and no `CLAUDE.md` in the folder. I will use the built-in make-changes and design-check rules.
- **Browser for screenshots:** found (Google Chrome). Node is v25.9.0, so the checks will run.
- **Result goes to:** a local link only. Nothing is published, pushed or committed.
- **Stop fact:** the "New appointment" button opens the wizard. Its 3 steps, fields, buttons and look match the reference. Every other screen of the prototype is unchanged, and the link opens.

## Request list

| # | Note, in words | Screens | Where | Check | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Add the New appointment flow as a 3-step wizard: a progress bar of 3 segments (first lit), then a card with the step content, then a Back and a Next button row | new-appointment (new) | this place | every part of the reference is found in the flow; the segments light up 1, 2, 3 as you go | todo |
| 2 | Step 1, "Who is coming in?", hint "Search for a client, or add a new one.", with a "Client name" box | new-appointment | this place | the text and the box are there on step 1 | todo |
| 3 | Step 2, "Pick a time", hint "Times with a free therapist and a free room.", four time buttons 09:00, 09:45, 10:30, 11:15, with 10:30 shown as picked | new-appointment | this place | the text and 4 buttons are there on step 2; 10:30 is marked picked | todo |
| 4 | Step 3, "Check and book", hint "We text the client a reminder the day before.", with the 3-line summary: Client: Priya Nair, Time: 10:30 with Tom Hale, Room 1, Type: Follow-up, 45 minutes | new-appointment | this place | the text and the 3 lines are there on step 3 | todo |
| 5 | Buttons behave like the reference: Next goes forward, Back goes back (nothing happens on step 1), the last step's button reads "Book" and shows an alert saying "Booked" (my reading: the same alert, with no booking saved, as in the reference) | new-appointment | this place | click Next twice: step 3 shows "Book"; Back returns; Book raises the alert "Booked" | todo |
| 6 | Same look as the reference: serif (Georgia) type, cream page, white card with a 14px radius and 28px padding, 560px wide, green accent #0a7d6b, same bar, buttons and spacing | new-appointment | this place | measured values on the flow equal the reference's, written side by side | todo |
| 7 | The "New appointment" button on Today opens the flow (my reading: it goes to its own screen at `#/new-appointment`, with the header kept and no nav tab added) | today, new-appointment | this place | click "New appointment" on Today and the first step shows | todo |

**Broken before the run** (found while reading the code, to be confirmed with screenshots): the "New appointment" button on Today has no handler. Row 7 makes it work, since you asked for it. I will not fix anything else I find broken. The Overdue filter on Invoices shows an empty table with no words, and I will leave it alone.

**Proposals** (not built in this run): none yet.

## Questions

Notes you send later still join this run.

1. **Anything missing or wrong in the list above?** Default: it is right as written.
2. **Where does the wizard sit?** Default: its own screen at `#/new-appointment`, opened by the Today button, with the prototype's header kept around it. The other choice is a dialog over Today.
3. **Where does the reference's look stop?** The reference's serif type and green accent differ from the clinic's sans type and blue accent. Default: the wizard keeps the reference's look exactly, and the header, nav and every other screen keep the clinic's look.
4. **Sample content.** The reference has fixed sample content (Priya Nair, 10:30 with Tom Hale). Default: copy it as is, since you said "exactly". The flow is not tied to the clinic's client or appointment data, and "Book" does not add a row to Today.
5. **Does the last step add a row to Today?** Default: no, "Book" only shows the alert "Booked", as in the reference.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
